title: isSuccessfulAIExtraction rejects a response whose extracted_metadata is an array
description: evidence-ai-response.js::isSuccessfulAIExtraction requires response.success===true AND extracted_metadata to be a non-array object. Guards against a malformed/legacy Python service payload being treated as a successful extraction.
steps: Call isSuccessfulAIExtraction({ success: true, extracted_metadata: { title: {} } })
expectedResult: First call returns false (array is not treated as a valid metadata object); second call returns true.

title: getAIExtractionError falls back through response.data.detail, message, reason.message, then a default string
preconditions: Simulated Promise.allSettled 'rejected' results with varying shapes
steps: Call getAIExtractionError with a reason where reason.response.data.detail = 'Unsupported file type: .exe'
Call it with a reason where only reason.message is set
Call it with an empty reason object {}
expectedResult: First call returns 'Unsupported file type: .exe'; second returns reason.message; third falls back to the default 'AI extraction failed' string.

title: computeChecksum produces a deterministic SHA-256 hex digest for identical buffers
description: S3FileStorageIntegration.computeChecksum(buffer, algorithm='sha256') wraps crypto.createHash('sha256'). The evidence-upload.worker.js computes this before every S3 PUT and stores it under files.$.checksum.value.
steps: Call computeChecksum(Buffer.from('evidence-content')) twice with the same input
Call computeChecksum with a single byte changed
expectedResult: Both identical-input calls return the same 64-character hex string; the changed-byte call returns a different digest.

title: generateKey sanitizes the filename to [a-zA-Z0-9._-] and includes evidence/{orgId}/{evidenceId}/ prefix
expectedResult: Returned key matches 'evidence/{orgId}/{evidenceId}/{timestamp}-Report-final-v2-3.pdf' (or equivalent), containing no parentheses, spaces, or '#' characters, and begins with the caller's own orgId segment.

title: Classification confidence formula computes min(1.0, 0.5 + gap*10.0) from the top-2 score gap
description: evidence_classification_service.py derives confidence from the margin between the #1 and #2 combined category+subcategory scores, not from the raw similarity itself.
steps: Feed two combined scores with a gap of 0.05 (e.g. 0.82 and 0.77) into the confidence formula
Feed two combined scores with a gap of 0.0 (a tie)
expectedResult: First case yields confidence ~1.0 (0.5 + 0.05*10 = 1.0, capped); second case yields confidence 0.5 (the documented 'uncertain classification' floor).

title: Combined category/subcategory score weights (0.40 category + 0.60 subcategory) select the correct winner
steps: Run get_category_subcategory_ids and inspect which candidate wins
expectedResult: Candidate B wins (0.75 > 0.66) even though its raw category similarity is lower, confirming the subcategory-weighted formula is applied as documented (CAT_WEIGHT=0.40, SUBCAT_WEIGHT=0.60).

title: evidence-ai-billing.service enforces the default annual AI-upload allowance of 50 when no plan override exists
description: DEFAULT_AI_UPLOADS_PER_YEAR = 50 in evidence-ai-billing.service.js; -1 denotes unlimited. Allowance can be scoped per-project when billingMode==='project'.
preconditions: Org has no explicit aiUploadPerYear override on its plan config
steps: Simulate 50 prior AI uploads counted for the current annual window
Call the allowance check for a 51st AI upload
expectedResult: The check throws AppError with status 402 and code EM_AI_UPLOADS_EXHAUSTED, message 'AI-assisted upload limit reached (50/year). Upgrade your plan.'

title: WorkflowTransitionService rejects an evidence under_review -> needs_revision transition submitted without a comment
description: featureWorkflows.js declares commentRequiredTransitions: [['under_review','needs_revision']] for the evidence feature — rejecting AI-assisted evidence must always carry a reason.
steps: Call WorkflowTransitionService.transition('evidence', id, 'needs_revision', { comment: undefined }) from state 'under_review'
expectedResult: Transition is rejected with a validation error requiring a comment; the evidence document's status remains 'under_review'.
